own_solution.law: Doppler effect, moving source, stationary listener, still air: f' = f v/(v - v_s)
assumptions: source moves directly toward listener along the line joining them

notes: Base: 440*343/323 = 467.245 Hz. Tuned siren: 456*343/323 = 484.235 Hz (measurement is after the sound emitted post-tuning arrives, as the base states). The 300 m distance enters the wave-front travel times of the Doppler derivation but cancels for straight-line constant-velocity approach; it could also be called K (matters only once the siren passes the listener, which the base excludes by 'still approaching'). TE5DD and T4EE7 are variants with the same 300 m. Earlier-run tuning (T62DC, TEE83) is disconnected because the base fixes the tone as emitted at switch-on in this run. Violin sentences are disconnected. T62DC and TEDCB carry no number (presumably numeral-free controls).
